key.name: radius-times
key.summary: Percentage of rounded corners for the panel in floating mode, 100 is completely round, 0 is no rounded corners

key.name: float-width
key.summary: The horizontal size (which I'll call "length" or "width" depending on your preference) of the panel when it's in floating mode.

key.name: float-align
key.summary: Alignment of the panel in floating mode, 0 for left, 1 for center, 2 for right

key.name: top-margin
key.summary: The distance between the panel and the top edge of the screen when in floating mode. This setting will not be applied in Solid Mode.

key.name: side-margin
key.summary: The distance between the panel and the left or right edge of the screen when in floating mode. Whether it's the left or right edge depends on whether you're left-aligned or right-aligned. This setting is not available when center-aligned.

key.name: transparent
key.summary: Opacity in floating mode, 0 is completely transparent, 100 is completely opaque. The panel menu also adheres to this setting.

key.name: transparent-menus
key.summary: The name is a legacy issue. It now actually indicates whether the panel menu should apply the same style as the panel, including color, etc., not just opacity.

key.name: transparent-menus-keep-alpha
key.summary: This option indicates whether the panel menu should always remain transparent. By default, it maintains the same transparency as the panel, so it will also become opaque in physical mode. Enabling this option will allow it to remain transparent even in physical mode.

key.name: duration
key.summary: Duration of the animation, may not have an effect on the panel background gradient.

key.name: auto-background
key.summary: Automatic background color: On/Off

key.name: dark-bg-color
key.summary: Custom dark mode background color

key.name: dark-fg-color
key.summary: Custom dark mode foreground color

key.name: light-bg-color
key.summary: Custom light mode background color

key.name: light-fg-color
key.summary: Custom light mode foreground color

key.name: colors-use-in-static
key.summary: Whether to apply the custom color to physical mode.

key.name: detection-mode
key.summary: The trigger to switch between Solid Mode and Floating Mode. By default, the panel will switch to Solid Mode when windows is close enough, without needing to maximize it.

key.name: background-mode
key.summary: Background style of the panel when floating, 0 for a single background for the entire panel, 1 for applying backgrounds separately to the left, center, and right sections of the panel.

key.name: auto-width
key.summary: Automatically determine the panel's horizontal size. When enabled, float-width will be unavailable.

key.name: solid-type
key.summary: The type of Solid Mode the panel is in. 0 is a dock similar to the default GNOME panel, 1 will hide the panel.

key.name: blur
key.summary: built-in blur effect in the switch

key.name: addon-trigger-left
key.summary: addon trigger area for activities

key.name: addon-trigger-center
key.summary: addon trigger area for datamenu

key.name: addon-trigger-right
key.summary: addon trigger area for quick settings

key.name: stable-workarea
key.summary: Keep the space reserved for the panel constant, so windows are not resized when the panel switches between the Floating and Solid modes

key.name: animate-width
key.summary: Animate the width of the panel during transitions (smoother, but heavier: the whole panel is laid out again on every frame)

key.name: pipelines
key.summary: A dictionary describing the different pipelines and their effects.

key.name: debug
key.summary: Boolean, set to true to activate debug mode (more verbose journalctl logs)

key.name: power-saver
key.summary: Whether to disable the panel blur in Power Saver mode

key.name: blur-in-floating
key.summary: Whether to show the blur behind the main panel while the panel is in Floating Mode (also used by the Hide type of Solid Mode)

key.name: blur-in-solid
key.summary: Whether to show the blur behind the main panel while the panel is in Solid Mode (docked)

key.name: match-panel-shape
key.summary: Whether the blur of the main panel follows the shape of the panel (rounded corners, Area background mode) instead of the blur corner radius settings

key.name: use-panel-detection
key.summary: Whether the window proximity options of the blur use the the panel window detection (Floating Mode means no window near the main panel)

key.name: background-priority
key.summary: Which background wins on the main panel when both are set: 0 the the panel colors, 1 the blur background style

key.name: blur
key.summary: Boolean, whether to blur the panels (disabled by default so the panel keeps its previous look until enabled)

key.name: pipeline
key.summary: String, the name of the pipeline to use. It must exist, else "pipeline_default" will be used

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Radius for the corner rounding effect

key.name: rounded-corners
key.summary: Corners to round (0 all, 1 top, 2 bottom, 3 none)

key.name: static-blur
key.summary: Boolean, whether to use a static or dynamic blur

key.name: unblur-in-overview
key.summary: Boolean, whether to disable the blur when opening the overview or not

key.name: force-light-text
key.summary: Boolean, whether or not to force the panel to have light text, useful when using light theme

key.name: match-theme-in-overview
key.summary: Boolean, whether to keep panel text and icons matched to the system theme in overview

key.name: override-background
key.summary: Boolean, whether to override the background or not

key.name: style-panel
key.summary: Enum to select the style of the panel (0 transparent, 1 light, 2 dark, 3 contrasted, 4 automatic)

key.name: override-background-dynamically
key.summary: Boolean, whether to change the background when a window is close to the panel

key.name: override-background-dynamically-mode
key.summary: Enum to select the override mode (0 Blur on Window Proximity, 1 Background on Window Proximity). Requires "override-background-dynamically" to be enabled.

key.name: gradient-panel
key.summary: Boolean, whether to enable the gradient panel effect

key.name: gradient-panel-mode
key.summary: Enum to select the gradient panel mode (0 Top, 1 Bottom). Requires "gradient-panel" to be enabled.

key.name: compatibility
key.summary: Boolean, whether to try compatibility with hidetopbar@mathieu.bidon.ca or not

key.name: blur-original-panel
key.summary: Boolean, whether to blur the original panel (if option selected) with Dash to Panel
